quarterly_data.signal: 9M2026 segment profit detail (results release): the Technology segment (Global and Domestic IT Services) contributed 89% of revenue and 58% of profit before tax, with PBT of VND5,052 billion (+16.6% YoY); the Education, Investment and Others businesses had revenue of VND4,508 billion (-3.1% YoY) and PBT of VND3,719 billion (+17.6%), mainly on double-digit earnings growth from associates and joint ventures. FPT was granted a Certificate of Eligibility to provide Data Intermediary Products and Services (secure data sharing, connectivity and utilization services).
